Eagle Eye vs Local Falcon

Local Falcon is the best-known geo-grid tracker and, like Eagle Eye, scans both Google and Apple Maps. Eagle Eye's difference is in the economics: credits that never expire, a free first scan with no card, and a competitor map built in.

What Eagle Eye does differently

Both tools cover Google and Apple, so the decision comes down to how you buy and what you get around the grid. Eagle Eye sells credits that never expire — buy them once and spend them when a client campaign actually needs a scan, instead of losing an unused monthly allotment. Every scan also renders a competitor map so you can see exactly which rival is sitting on each grid point you don't own, plus LSOV, ARP and ATRP in one view.

When to choose each

Choose Local Falcon if you want the most established brand in geo-grid tracking and the ecosystem that has grown around it. Choose Eagle Eye if you want the same Google + Apple coverage with credits that don't expire, a free first scan to prove value with no card, and a competitor map on every run.

Bottom line

Closest match on map coverage; Eagle Eye wins on credit economics and a free, no-card start.

Three numbers, every scan

Three numbers a client remembers and a trend that proves your work paid off. Every scan rolls the whole grid into them — no spreadsheet, no hand-waving.

LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.

Questions, answered

Does Eagle Eye scan Apple Maps like Local Falcon?

Yes — Eagle Eye runs a geo-grid on both Google and Apple Maps at the same price.

What happens to credits I don't use?

They never expire. One credit scans one grid point (81 at 9×9, 441 at 21×21).

Can I try it before paying?

Yes — your first scan is free and no card is required.

See the blocks you're winning — and the ones you're not

Run a real geo-grid scan on your own business, any size, no card. In minutes you'll see every block you own, every block a rival is taking, and the one number you can hand a client.
